title: Kindness Delivery
shareTitle: Kindness Delivery — Draw, Fold, and Fly a Kind Note
description: Choose a papercraft friend, draw and decorate a real kindness note, fold it into a paper plane, and swipe it across the garden for a joyful delivery.
learningGoals: Express warmth and care through an original visual message
Compose a supportive note with drawing, stamps, and stickers
Connect a kind intention on screen to a small caring action nearby
interactionModel: choose Fox, Bunny, or Bear; author a real normalized canvas note with crayons, stamps, and movable stickers; recoverably undo or clear it; fold the child's work into a plane; then swipe or press the oversized plane to deliver it
feedbackModel: every intentional launch succeeds; papercraft motion, a heart trail, recorded teacher narration, synthesized tactile sound effects, and each friend's unique full-body reaction celebrate the child's own note without scores or failure

modes.title: Bear
modes.skill: connect a kind intention to a real-world act
